note: Abstract structural parameters for `uie roll` (METHODS §6; ADR-013). They are classes, never named fonts, palettes or products, so that the roll varies structure without recommending a look. Weights below 1 demote values that research found to be generator defaults (e.g. the split fold, 02 §2.6). Mode filters keep Operate and Read surfaces conventional in structure (P3).

values.value: statement-led: one sentence carries the first viewport
artefact-led: the product's own artefact (record, document, object) is the hero
task-first: the primary task's form or search starts in the first viewport
index-led: a list or table of real items opens the page
evidence-led: a real measurement, map or timeline from the facts section
editorial: headline, standfirst and body in reading order
split: text beside a product image
centred statement with one action
single column with a reading measure
two columns with a dominant main column
asymmetric grid with key lines
list-detail panes
full-bleed sections alternating with contained sections
modular grid of unequal items (only when items differ in importance)
restrained
committed
full-palette
drenched
one family, contrast through weight and size
serif display with sans text
sans display with serif text
one sans family plus monospace for data only
one serif family throughout
condensed or wide display with a neutral text face

operate: one family, contrast through weight and size
one sans family plus monospace for data only

values.value: comfortable
compact
spacious
calm: feedback and state only
balanced: plus one page fade or one orchestrated sequence
bold: plus declared scroll-linked effects (Experience only)
